hypotheses.R0_exactness_survives: State recomposition and Shapley relative errors are at most 1e-5, base replay logit error is at most 1e-4, and head-sum state error is at most 1e-3.
hypotheses.R1_crossing_depth_generalizes: Discovery and held-out first-crossing layers differ by at most two for at least six families.
hypotheses.R2_material_attention_is_not_universal: At least one operational family has attention-branch target RMS below 10% of native semantic-effect RMS at its frozen site.
hypotheses.R3_material_attention_remains_compact: Among families passing the attention materiality gate, at least four frozen top-three programs retain held-out energy fidelity 0.80.
hypotheses.R4_discovery_rankings_beat_equal_size_su: For at least four material families, the frozen top-three program is at or above the 90th percentile of all 84 three-head subsets on held-out pairs.
hypotheses.R5_small_family_panels_are_disclosed: Families with fewer than four held-out pairs are marked exploratory rather than treated as strong replication.
